newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metrobank jumps 12.77 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank jumps 12.77 pct in early trade.

text.p: Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co (Metrobank) rose 60 pesos, or 12.77 percent, at 530 pesos in early Friday trade, riding the wave of general buying after the Central Bank decided to let the peso weaken, brokers said.

"Metrobank was really one of the stocks at its low in recent days. It's benefiting from the general recovery of the market," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities.
Metrobank was the second most heavily traded issue early in the session with 73.97 million pesos in turnover.
The Central Bank on Friday effectively devalued the peso after saying it would allow it to trade in a wider range.
